name: SMA Crossover Strategy - AAPL (20/50)
description: 20/50 SMA crossover on AAPL daily prices. Long when 20-day SMA crosses above 50-day SMA, flat otherwise. Fixed 100% equity allocation when in position.
source:
# SMA Crossover Strategy - AAPL (30/100)
# 30/100 SMA crossover on AAPL daily close prices
# Long when 30-day SMA crosses above 100-day SMA, flat otherwise
# 100% equity allocation when in position

# Daily OHLCV data
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# Fast (30-day) and Slow (100-day) SMA
fast_sma = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(close)
slow_sma = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(close)

# Trend signal: bullish when fast > slow
is_bullish = fast_sma > slow_sma
is_bearish = fast_sma < slow_sma

# Hold position between crossover events
held = hold_until()(enter=is_bullish, exit=is_bearish)

# Execution - long only
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held)

# Full equity allocation when in position
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=100)
